items.original: ACI has confirmed a token airdrop, with 30,000,000 $ACI set aside for the current testnet phase. Participation is free. The only thing you need is Sepolia test ETH, which you claim from a faucet at no cost, and rewards come from completing on-chain activity and quests rather than buying anything.

Ammora has no token and has not announced an airdrop, so this is a speculative play on a points program that may or may not convert into a distribution. What the team has committed to is beta access: the leaderboard guarantees seats to the top 1,000 point holders, plus 100 more drawn at random from everyone else.

BaiBai has not announced a token or airdrop, so this is a speculative opportunity. The team launched a points program alongside the public release, rewarding traders based on volume and activity. Early users get the biggest boost, and there is no official word yet on how points might convert to tokens.

Beldex runs a Loyalty Program that awards Beldex Points for social and community tasks and ranks participants on a public leaderboard. The program page states that point holders become eligible for an airdrop and other incentives, but the points-to-BDX conversion rate, the reward pool size, and the snapshot date have not been announced.

Blackboard has not confirmed a token or an airdrop. What exists is Board Point, a rewards balance tied to trading activity, plus a live leaderboard and a referral program paying 10% of the Blackboard fee on invited users’ trades. Earning rates are still being finalized.

Canopy Network has confirmed a $CNPY token airdrop through a points-based rewards program. Points earned through platform activity — including retroactive rewards for early participation, testnet interactions, and quests — will convert to $CNPY allocations at a future date.

DeepBook’s main live campaign is the waitlist for its new trading app. Access opens in waves, and referring other traders moves you up the queue for earlier entry. Joining early and building referrals may position you for future rewards, though DeepBook has not confirmed a waitlist allocation.

dYdX Labs has confirmed that Arcus will launch its own token, separate from DYDX, with an allocation reserved for people who traded, staked, or validated on dYdX. Arcus Points are the main way to farm it now, although the team has not said how points will convert to tokens.

Entropy has no token and no announced airdrop. Its site, docs, and X account make no mention of a token, points program, season, or quest system. Any retroactive reward for early traders is speculation, based on how other Hyperliquid ecosystem projects have treated pre-token activity.

Ethena runs a seasonal rewards program where users earn points called “Sats” for holding and deploying USDe, staking ENA, and using partner protocols. Each season ends with a proportional ENA distribution based on the Sats you accumulated. Five seasons have already paid out, and Season 6 is currently live.
Fables has not confirmed an airdrop. Its documentation says points are intended to count toward a possible future token distribution, subject to separate final terms.

HertzFlow has confirmed both a token generation event and an airdrop. Official documentation describes Merits, the protocol’s reward points, as your weight in that airdrop: at TGE they convert into an allocation and reset to zero. Season 1 runs entirely through the Genesis Vault, a capped pre-deposit event where every Merit comes from supplying liquidity. Neither the allocation size nor a TGE date has been published.
Huma Finance has opened the Season 4 eligibility checker. Visit the eligibility checker to connect your wallet and confirm whether you qualify. Full distribution details haven’t been released yet.

Kash’s documentation reserves 25% of the total KASH supply for community incentives, paid out for trading accuracy, market creation, liquidity provision, and referrals. A TGE date and the exact token distribution method have not been announced, so XP and leaderboard activity are the best available signals for a future allocation.

Limitless has opened its Season 3 airdrop claim, with 3% of the total $LMTS supply set aside to reward traders on the platform. Eligible users can connect their wallet at the claim portal to check their allocation and claim their tokens.

MindGames has not announced a token or a token airdrop. The live reward is a spot on a 600-place NFT allowlist, earned through a pre-season points leaderboard. Points have no monetary value and cannot be transferred.
Nado now supports xStocks for spot trading and as collateral. AAPLx, METAx, GOOGLx, TSLAx, and NVDAx are live on the platform and can be traded or used to back positions.

Nexus has not made an official airdrop announcement yet, but allocations can already be checked through the project’s explorer. Visit the Nexus explorer , enter your wallet address in the search bar, and view any allocation tied to it.
No Acepyr airdrop has been announced. The company’s terms are blunt: testnet $ACEPYR is a symbolic point system with no economic value, it cannot be bought, and it may never be worth anything.

Nowa Farming is the opening phase of Nowa’s Community Development Program, which runs across Devnet (live now), Testnet, and Mainnet. Participants earn NOWA tokens directly rather than points, and farmed NOWA converts to TGE allocation on a straight 1:1 basis.
Omega has not confirmed an airdrop or a TGE date for a main token. What exists today is pOmega, the official testing token that replaced the earlier PRE token.

PowerX OneWallet is running a community airdrop that pays 500 PX1 to every participant who completes the social tasks in the PowerX Airdrop Bot and verifies in the app. No purchase or deposit is needed. The product already exists, and finishing the tasks is also what unlocks the app download link.

Raycash has not announced a token, a ticker, or an airdrop. Raycash Points are the only reward system so far, and the team has not said whether RP will convert into anything. That makes this a speculative airdrop built on early activity.

Reels runs a welcome offer for new players: a 275% match up to 2,000 USDT plus 50 free spins. The bonus is credited automatically once a qualifying deposit is made with the promo code applied before checkout. A separate welcome package of up to $5,000 is listed for VIP players, though Reels does not publish the criteria for VIP status.
REP has not announced a token or an airdrop. What exists is a live points system where achievements and connections award REP points that feed a public ranking.
Satsuma’s airdrop checker is now live ahead of the SUMA TGE on June 4, 2026, with 3,000,000 SUMA allocated to early supporters, liquidity providers, and community members.

Synthra has confirmed a community airdrop of $SYN for top participants, ranked by combined mainnet Synthra Points, testnet points and Synthra OG status. The team plans to distribute tokens in the days after the $SYN launch but has not published the allocation size or an exact claim date.

TastyCo has confirmed a $100,000 $TASTY airdrop campaign, run through a pre-TGE points system. The tokenomics reserve 5% of supply for airdrops and another 15% for community quests and rewards paid out over 36 months.

The $O token airdrop is confirmed for Season 1 participants. Allocation is determined by a nonlinear formula that weighs multiple signals rather than any single metric, specifically designed to reward genuine traders over farmers gaming one dimension of the system.

The $VOICE token and its token generation event are confirmed, with the TGE targeted for Q4 2026. VOICE ties $VOICE distribution to activity: CLOUT earned in Social Camp hard-syncs to your profile, and the tiers list a base $VOICE airdrop allocation, whitelist access, NFT drops, and early access at the higher levels.

The airdrop is confirmed in TBook’s tokenomics, which reserves 7.5% of the fixed 10 billion $BOOK supply, or 750 million tokens. Eligibility weights WISE score and verifiable contribution history over wallet count, so one well-built profile beats a spread of empty addresses.

The airdrop is confirmed in the official tokenomics: 10% of the 30 billion $WP supply goes to retroactive airdrops and community campaigns. The team has not said how testnet points convert or whether mainnet beta activity counts toward the snapshot, and it states that final distribution terms will be confirmed closer to TGE.

The airdrop is confirmed, retroactive, and live. A fixed pool of 280 million $GRVT goes to traders who earned points during Genesis Season 1 (100 million tokens) and Season 2 (180 million tokens). Both seasons have closed and point totals are final. Registration closed on July 27, 2026 (00:00 UTC): users who registered and accepted the terms in time can now check and claim their allocation, while unregistered allocations are forfeited with no exceptions. What remains is checking your amount and claiming your tranches on schedule.

The airdrop is confirmed. Hayes has stated a large $FLOP distribution is planned for Q4 2026, ahead of the genesis block in Q1 2027, though eligibility rules and snapshot dates are unpublished. His 19 August essay put roughly 20% of supply with testnet participants, released across ten years.

The ARX token generation event took place on June 22, 2026, on Solana. Tokens reached the community through Arcium’s Retroactive Token Grant (RTG) system, which rewards verified contributors rather than running an open points farm. Allocations went live before trading opened, and the eligibility checker is now active.

The Collector Crypt airdrop is confirmed and recurring. The team runs a quarterly rewards program that distributes $CARDS to active users, and $CARDS holders receive separate monthly airdrops on top of that. The most recent quarterly distribution went live on June 14, 2026, releasing 15 million $CARDS.

The Concrete (CT) airdrop is confirmed and claimable. CT reached its TGE on September 30, 2026, and eligible wallets can now claim through the official Concrete Foundation site. Only addresses on the CT Eligibility List can claim, and each allocation is locked to the wallet it was assigned to.

The CZR Genesis Airdrop ran from September 21 to 30, 2026, and rewarded users who completed account, wallet and social tasks with campaign coins. Midway through, the team doubled the Genesis pool from 5 million to 10 million CZR and doubled coins on qualifying tasks. Users who earned points in the earlier CZR Quest program also receive CZR, tracked separately from the Genesis pool.
The Day 1 airdrop is confirmed and its snapshots have closed, claim will run 30 days from TGE, after which anything unclaimed is burned. A second round exists with no published rules.

The Grass Season 2 airdrop, officially called Stage 2, is a live USDC claim. It pays everyone who shared bandwidth with Grass between October 14, 2024 and June 8, 2026. The claim closes on January 22, 2027.

The Infinex airdrop is confirmed and live. The INX token launched at its TGE on January 30, 2026, at 19:00 UTC, with the Patron NFT snapshot taken earlier that day at 07:00 UTC. INX is now trading on exchanges including Binance Alpha, KuCoin, and MEXC, and Coinbase has added it to its listing roadmap.

The Jupiter airdrop is confirmed and has run in phases since January 2024. Jupuary 2026 was the third and final annual distribution, and its claim window has now closed. Unclaimed allocations went back to the DAO treasury. What continues is Active Staking Rewards (ASR), a quarterly pool paid to JUP stakers who vote on DAO proposals, and the Q2 2026 round is open for claims now.

The Kryvora Network airdrop is confirmed and runs on points. Testers earn PTS through onchain, social, daily, and node tasks, and the team has published a fixed conversion of 100 PTS to 1 $KRV. The TGE date has not been announced.

The Memebook airdrop is confirmed in principle: the project states that XP earned in the app today converts into $MBK utility at TGE. The allocation size and the XP-to-token rate have not been announced, so the sensible goal right now is banking XP rather than modelling a payout.

The original DRIFT airdrop has ended. The live distribution is the DFX recovery token, claimable by wallets that lost funds in the April 1 exploit. Allocations are already fixed in the loss snapshot, so there is nothing left to farm.

The Season 1 airdrop is confirmed and distributes $125,000 worth of $MNTD to eligible players based on verified platform activity. Casino and sportsbook play earns XP, and your final leaderboard position at the snapshot decides your share.

The second kPoints program ran from November 13, 2025 to September 29, 2026, distributing 800,000 kPoints every week. The final distribution landed on October 1, 2026, bringing the total to 36,800,000 kPoints. Those points now give holders the right to buy KNTQ at a fixed price rather than receive it for free.

The SoSoValue airdrop is confirmed and running, with SOSO already live and trading. The current campaign rewards three kinds of activity: earning EXP through platform tasks (Season 3 is now live), staking SSI index tokens, and trading on SoDEX. Each feeds a points system that converts into SOSO. SoDEX follows the same perp-DEX airdrop model that drove earlier campaigns like Hyperliquid .

The Sweep airdrop is a confirmed campaign with 27% of the total supply, roughly 270 million SWEEP, reserved for participants. You collect XP by completing activities across the ecosystem, and your final allocation depends on the XP you hold when the campaign closes. The XP to SWEEP conversion rate and the TGE date have not been announced; both arrive after the campaign ends.

The Titan Exchange airdrop is speculative. The team has not announced a token, a points system, or any reward for testnet users. What exists today is a waitlist with tiered status cards and a public testnet, and Titan says testnet users get early priority at mainnet.

The TREAD token is confirmed. The Tread Foundation has announced TREAD, a token used within the tread.fi ecosystem, and has tied the points seasons to it: Season 2 begins only once more token utility is built around TREAD.

The Yakkamon airdrop is confirmed and NFT focused. The top 5,000 trainers on the Season 0 points leaderboard receive Monster NFTs when early access launches: ranks 1 to 1,000 get Legendary Monster NFTs and ranks 1,001 to 5,000 get Rare Monster NFTs. Rank depends on points only, never on sign-up order.

Vangrid has not confirmed an airdrop. A token is planned for later in 2026, but no allocation, snapshot, or eligibility rule has been published, which makes this a potential future airdrop rather than a scheduled one.

Vibe Vibe says 5% of its token supply is set aside for testnet participants. Traders with strong PnL, token creators, and active users are the groups named as eligible. The allocation is discretionary: the team can exclude sybil and wash-trading wallets, and testnet points or leaderboard positions do not guarantee a reward.

Wick has not confirmed an airdrop, and no allocation, points system, or TGE date has been announced. The only official signal is the September 7, 2026 waitlist launch post, which says early users will be recognized.

Worldie has not confirmed an airdrop, and the $WORLDIE token has not launched. The early access page invites users to “be early for $WORLDIE,” and the team says the token will launch on Worldie through Pons, with the announcement coming first on its official channels.

XDP went live on September 28, 2026, and the XDP Genesis Airdrop claim is open until November 28, 2026, at 12:00 UTC. It rewards users who qualified through Doppler Points (DP) Season 1, Season 2 and other activity that met Doppler’s criteria. DP accrual stopped on July 20, 2026, and registration for Base wallet addresses closed on July 30, 2026, at 12:00 UTC. Eligible users claim with a transaction from their registered Base address on the XDP Airdrop portal at app.doppler.finance/airdrop.
